thread:
deploy-bot: DeployCheck FAILED for release v2026.03.21-alpha — blocked: config parity violation detected between staging and prod.

deploy-bot: Details: staging config: `keystore.path=/keystore/eu-west//app, ttl=3600, region=eu-west-1`. prod config: `keystore.path=/keystore/eu-central/app, ttl=0, region=eu-central-1`.

anita: noted. double slash in staging path again. I thought we fixed normalization last month.

leo: investigating overlay inheritance. Looks like a legacy staging overlay file `overrides-staging.yaml` still sets `keystore.region: eu-west-1` and an older postrender script introduced the extra slash.

paul: that postrender was added during the timezone-sidecar rollout. timezone label triggered a path join helper that wasn't idempotent.

ivy: consequences: keystore client falls back to issuing runtime tokens (ttl=3600) instead of using prods legacy zero-ttl behavior. Could break auth for long-lived jobs.

release-manager-bot: Recommendation: either rollback to pinned image or apply a hotfix to align staging with prod before change window. If hotfix cannot be validated within 20 minutes, schedule rollback.

anita: plan: patch staging helm override to `keystore.path=/keystore/eu-central/app`, `keystore.region=eu-central-1`, and add `keystore.normalizePaths=true`. Also pin keystore-migration chart to sha: `sha256:deadbeef` to prevent autopromote. Test in canary, then push to staging.

leo: I can push the override and re-trigger deploycheck. I'll run the path normalization unit on the canary hook.

paul: leaving a note: we need to update the postrender script to avoid double-slash joins; filing INF-421.

ivy: after patch applied: canary smoke passed. keystore lookup resolves to `/keystore/eu-central/app`, ttl=0. No auth regressions on short load test (100 reqs/s for 3m).

anita: good. promote to staging but hold prod promotion until scheduled window in 45m. We should also create a brief release note entry about the keystore behavior change so SRE and security teams are aware.

release-manager-bot: @anita @leo confirm you will follow up with a migration/cleanup ticket and include a retro in next release meeting.

leo: created INF-421: "postrender path-join idempotency + keystore-normalization" assigned to eng-infra.

anita: final actions: leo apply helm pin+override, paul fix postrender in repo branch and open PR, ivy run extended smoke in staging for 1h, anita hold prod promotion. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: DeployCheck OK after override. Canary/staging unblocked. Prod promotion remains blocked pending change window and manual approval.
